name: Web Manuals Amelia AI Compliance Assistant
summary: New at NBAA-BACE (AIN, October 20): a Compliance Assistant inside Web Manuals' Amelia AI document platform that helps operators identify rule changes, with updates that include integration of FAA Data Collection Tools. Amelia AI already searches and helps co-author an operator's manuals. Web Manuals is at booth 2457.
paragraphs: New at NBAA-BACE (AIN, October 20): a Compliance Assistant inside Web Manuals' Amelia AI document platform that helps operators identify rule changes, with updates that include integration of FAA Data Collection Tools. Amelia AI already searches and helps co-author an operator's manuals. Web Manuals is at booth 2457.
whyItMatters: Finding the right page in your own manuals, and knowing when a rule change means a manual revision, is hours of skilled time every month. At the show, bring a recent rule change and see how quickly it points to the sections you actually had to update.
